items.source:
This filter is useful when matching needs to be made based on potentially the
whole class/interface hierarchy. The algorithm employed uses a succeed-fast
strategy: if at any time a match is declared, no further processing is
carried out.
items.translation: 此过滤器在需要根据整个类/接口层次结构进行匹配时非常有用。所采用的算法使用快速成功策略：一旦在任何时候声明了匹配，就不再执行进一步的处理。

items.source:
Determine whether this filter matches for the class described by
the given metadata.
items.translation: 确定此过滤器是否匹配由给定元数据描述的类型。

items.source: Override this to match on type name.
items.translation: 覆盖它以匹配类型名称。

items.source: Override this to match on interface type name.
items.translation: 覆盖它以匹配接口类型名称。

items.source: Override this to match on supertype name.
items.translation: 覆盖它以匹配超类型名称。

items.source:
Override this to match self characteristics alone. Typically,
the implementation will use a visitor to extract information
to perform matching.
items.translation: 覆盖此方法以仅匹配自身特征。通常，实现会使用访问者来提取信息以执行匹配。

items.source: Override this to match self characteristics alone.
items.translation: 覆盖它以仅匹配自身特征。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O failure when reading metadata
items.translation: IOException - 读取元数据时发生 I/O 故障的情况

items.source: metadataReader - the metadata reader for the target class
items.translation: metadataReader - 目标类的元数据读取器

items.source: metadataReaderFactory - a factory for obtaining metadata readers for other classes (such as superclasses and interfaces)
items.translation: metadataReaderFactory - 用于获取其他类（如超类和接口）的元数据读取器的工厂
